display_name: James, companion of John the Bishop

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ιωάννης ο Επίσκοπος και Ιάκωβος ο Πρεσβύτερος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 1 ноября ст. ст., «Иаков Ревнитель, Персидский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives no by-name, as «Иакова пресвитера».

death.note: Two calendars a dozen years apart on one man, and the interval holds both. saint.gr gave «έζησαν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά των Περσών Σαβωρίου (332 μ.Χ.)», which this folder carried as about 332; days.pravoslavie.ru's line for the same pair on the same day closes «(ок. 345)», about 345. Nothing is chosen, and no year is taken from the life the calendar hangs behind his name, which is another man's.

feast.note: His name page lists this day and no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иоанна епископа и Иакова пресвитера, в Персии пострадавших (ок. 345).»

attestations.note: The line's «Сщмч.» is hieromartyr and its «пресвитера» presbyter, both of which this folder already held from saint.gr. The name link gives him two by-names the Greek page does not, «Иаков Ревнитель, Персидский», James the Zealot, the Persian. **The one life page the calendar hangs behind his name is another man's**: it is the life of a venerable martyr James tonsured at Dochiariou on the Holy Mountain, tortured to death with two disciples on 1 November 1520, whom this corpus holds as `james-of-kastoria` with `james-the-deacon-of-kastoria` and `dionysius-the-monk-of-kastoria` off saint.gr's own 1 November. A life that is about somebody else is not this saint's life, on the same reading BRIEF.md §4 gives for a mis-hung hymn, so no narrative is taken from it.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ιωάννης ο Επίσκοπος και Ιάκωβος ο Πρεσβύτερος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates two men, each with his own heading and his own rank, so it is two folders. The same day's listing keeps two other men named James, the venerable-martyr of Kastoria and his deacon, who are new folders of this batch and not this man; nothing on either page connects them. The English form hangs on his companion because the page gives him neither city nor epithet. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
